claims.statement: POST /imports accepts only application/pdf, returns 415 otherwise, maps UnsupportedStatement and ValueError to 422 without scheduling categorization, and on success returns 201 with ImportSummary then queues run_categorization_logged for pending rows only.

import_statement parses via detect_adapter, then in one transaction resolves the account by IBAN, inserts an imports row including the PDF SHA-256, and inserts transactions with on conflict (dedup_key) do nothing, counting rowcount as rows_new.
Account resolve reuses accounts.iban or inserts a new account named with the bank and the IBAN last four. The file hash is stored but is not the duplicate check.

The dedup key is a SHA-256 of IBAN, booking date, two-decimal amount, uppercased collapsed description, printed balance, and the in-file occurrence index of that fingerprint, so identical rows in one statement insert and the same movement in a later file conflicts.
New imported rows are income when amount is positive and expense otherwise, with category_source left at the column default none until categorization runs.
detect_adapter sniffs the first page of ADAPTERS in order (BBVA then CaixaBank) and raises UnsupportedStatement for an empty or unreadable PDF or an unrecognized statement.

BbvaPdfAdapter sniffs EXTRACTODE and F.Oper., parses dated rows plus a detail line for the calendar month of the EXTRACTO header, and checks the balance chain in ascending order. CaixaBankPdfAdapter sniffs ConceptoFechaImporteSaldo and Periodo, parses one concept-date-amount-balance line over the printed period, and checks the chain in descending order.
check_balance_chain raises ValueError and imports nothing when consecutive printed balances do not add up. It skips the check for fewer than two rows or any row without a printed balance.

structure stores BBVA text before ' | ' as bank_concept, leaves CaixaBank without a concept, strips 12-to-19 digit card numbers from concept and merchant, and keeps only card_last4. The explorer masks those digits in description_raw on read.
A successful import does not wait for categorization. run_categorization_logged holds a process-wide lock, logs and swallows failures, and a failed cascade still leaves the 201 and the inserted rows.

finance import uses the same import_statement, then runs categorization in-process after the files and prints a categorization exception without undoing the import. A bad file is stderr plus exit code 1 while other files still import.

Dashboard money reads sum v_transactions_enriched through the shared Scope filter. GET /dashboard/overview supplies untyped KPIs, expense breakdowns, a cumulative line omitted when there is no latest day, all-time group color slots, and a subscription summary that ignores the account filter.

GET /spending/detail is the shared scope read for a group, category, merchant, or income page: it picks expenses or income from totals, folds merchant children at 10, and returns five latest transactions plus the cumulative pair.

The home page reads GET /dashboard/overview and, when latest_day is null, shows an empty state that links to /imports instead of painting zeros. Spending and income pages are force-dynamic no-store fetches and do not recompute spend.

The imports page loads every import and every account, then renders UploadForm, CoverageBoard only when there is at least one import, and ImportHistory. UploadForm posts each selected PDF alone to POST /imports, shows new and duplicate counts, and refreshes without waiting for categorization. POST /imports still returns 201 after the insert and queues a pending-only categorization run.
A foreign Origin on POST /imports or POST /categorize/run is 403 before any insert or queued run. Requests with no Origin are accepted. TrustedHostMiddleware refuses a Host outside trusted_hosts.

Period resolution anchors relative periods on the latest booked_at of the selected accounts. Deltas use a same-day cut of the previous period when data ends inside the current period, while has_previous is judged on the whole previous period and the cumulative previous line is not cut.

GET /imports is uncapped and ordered by period_end descending with nulls last, then account name, then imported_at descending, because the coverage board reads the whole list. LIST_IMPORTS_SQL contains no limit.

Imports is a MORE_ITEMS destination, not a main nav pill. From lg up it opens from the Imports and settings menu; below lg the sheet lists it after the main pages. Its link does not keep period or account filters.

A filled coverage month means a statement period covers that account-month. The four states are covered, partial, gap, and outside. The current month is never a gap, because a month is expected only after its last day is before today. Two partials that together fill a month stay partial.

The coverage board opens on the year of the latest dated period_end. Its year arrows run from the earliest dated period_start year to the later of that year and the current year. The missing line lists the visible year's gaps, newest month first. A month popover does not filter or link.

Import history keeps the API order and groups rows by the YYYY-MM of period_end. A statement that spans months belongs to the month it ends. Null periods form a last group labelled No period. The filename stays on ImportRecord and is not rendered.
